title.narrative: Sava Re debt capital market issuance

description.narrative: Investment of €5 million in the inaugural debt capital market issuance of Pozavarovalnica Sava, d.d. ("Sava Re", or the "Issuer"), a re-insurance company in Slovenia, in the form of EUR-denominated subordinated bonds (the "Bonds") with an aggregate issuance amount of €50 million (the "Project"). The Bonds will be Solvency II compliant, eligible as Tier III capital. The Project supports the Issuer with its (i) inaugural debt capital market issuance as the first-ever Tier III subordinated bond issuance by an insurer in Slovenia and (ii) further expansion in the region, fostering market consolidation and competition.
